``draft`` for PRESERVE_DRAFT, ``conflict`` for RESOLVE_CONFLICT, and
``confirmation`` for CONFIRM.

ExploreResultsPresentationSuccess.description:

KeyboardBinding.title: KeyboardBindingWire

KillSwitchScope.description:

An active broader scope dominates narrower clear states; the scope
hash pins the exact scope identity used by state lookups.
KillSwitchScope.title: KillSwitchScope

Current kill-switch state for one exact scope.

Preflight and pre-dispatch checks read a known current version for the
exact scope; active, unknown, stale, unavailable, or version-mismatched
state blocks (fail-closed).
KillSwitchState.title: KillSwitchState

LayoutMigrationResult.description:
Wire-native layout migration outcome (record R29).

LayoutMigrationResult.title: LayoutMigrationResult

restore-path migration outcome, and ``template`` the saved or loaded
template.
ManageLayoutsPresentationSuccess.title: ManageLayoutsPresentationSuccess

Owner-required work monitoring event stream subscription (port 12).

``resume_event_id`` reconnects after interruption with ordered
replay/resync semantics and ``replay_limit`` bounds buffered replay
per FR-UI-STREAM_ACTIVITY.
MonitorWorkPresentationEventSubscription.title: MonitorWorkPresentationEventSubscription

MonitorWorkPresentationSuccess.description:
Successful monitor-work presentation result (port 12).

``progress`` carries tracked progress, ``notification`` deduplicated
outcome notices, and ``error`` structured failure presentations.
MonitorWorkPresentationSuccess.title: MonitorWorkPresentationSuccess

bounded bulk-action confirmation plan.
OperateDatabanksPresentationSuccess.title: OperateDatabanksPresentationSuccess

markets; ``resume_event_id`` reconnects with ordered replay/resync
semantics bounded by ``replay_limit``.
OperateTradingPresentationEventSubscript.title: OperateTradingPresentationEventSubscription

One governor check at its fixed precedence position.

``RiskDecision.ordered_checks``.

PanelContribution.title: PanelContributionWire

PortSpec.description: One named typed task port at a declared schema version.
PortSpec.title: PortSpec

PortfolioBuilderProjection.description:
Wire-native portfolio builder projection (record R13).

Every transport produces the same portfolio manifests and selected
results for the same versioned input.
PortfolioBuilderProjection.title: PortfolioBuilderProjection

PortfolioConstraintSet.description:
One declared portfolio constraint set (R5).

Breaches are prevented or resolved deterministically by the owning
feature; the record only freezes the declared limits.
PortfolioConstraintSet.title: PortfolioConstraintSet

PortfolioMember.description:
One constituent strategy version of a portfolio version (R3).

Admission validates date overlap, result compatibility, required
currencies, duplicate exposure, and constituent availability.
PortfolioMember.title: PortfolioMember

PortfolioResult.description:
One aggregate portfolio simulation result (R9).

Aggregate totals reconcile to constituents; ``.sqxpf`` export preserves
identities, policies, metrics, and artifacts and reproduces the
canonical portfolio hash on round-trip.
PortfolioResult.title: PortfolioResult

ProgressPresentation.description:
Wire projection of an async progress presentation (record R15).

Progress carries no fabricated precision: ``progress_percent`` is an
exact decimal string or the stage is indeterminate.
ProgressPresentation.title: ProgressPresentationWire

ProjectExpression.description:
One sandboxed deterministic project expression.

Conditions run over declared task results, counters, and variables only;
filesystem, network, clock, and undeclared access are impossible by
construction in the owning runtime, not by this wire record.
ProjectExpression.title: ProjectExpression

ProjectGraph.description:
One immutable executable task graph.

Domain assumptions: ``task_key`` values identify tasks uniquely inside
one graph, every transition endpoint must reference a declared task key,
and every transition lying on a directed cycle must carry an explicit
``cycle_bound`` so no reachable cycle is unbounded. ``GOTO`` and
``STOP_AND_START`` compile to explicit bounded transitions at runtime.
ProjectGraph.title: ProjectGraph

ProjectGraphProjection.description:
Wire-native project graph visualization projection (record R12).

A version rejected by the authoritative server validator carries its
issues and cannot be published through any transport.
ProjectGraphProjection.title: ProjectGraphProjection

ProposedAction.description:
One complete immutable proposed action bound for admission.

``intent`` embeds the complete Strategy intent or Trading manual plan
unchanged; Risk adds scope, valuation, stop, route, evidence, and the
requested risk profile without altering it.
ProposedAction.title: ProposedAction

ProtectionSet.description:
One versioned set of owned protective orders (record R19).

Protections bind an exact entry/order/position identity and never
attach to another strategy or manual action; protected quantity never
exceeds live residual quantity. Uniqueness
``(owner_identity, version)`` spans records and is store-enforced.
ProtectionSet.title: ProtectionSet

ProtectionSpec.description:
One protective-order specification inside a protection set (R19).

Inline nested record of ``ProtectionSet.protections``; not a numbered
public record itself.
ProtectionSpec.title: ProtectionSpec

ResearchBudget.description:
Bound set enforced by research budget governance.

Public record R18, defined ahead of the table order because
``ResearchManifest`` (R2) embeds it; every bound left ``None`` is
unbounded, and bound exhaustion is a runtime policy, not a record rule.
ResearchBudget.title: ResearchBudget

ResearchManifest.description:
Immutable pinned inputs of one research execution request (R2).

Equivalent requests from every entry point produce one manifest
``content_hash``; the approved preview hash must match at admission.
ResearchManifest.title: ResearchManifest

ResearchPreview.description:
Wire-native research preview and admission envelope (record R11).

Admission must supply the approved ``manifest_hash``; a mismatch or
any ``unbounded_domains`` member blocks launch.
ResearchPreview.title: ResearchPreview

ResearchRunRef.description:
Reference to one controllable research run execution (R1).

Start/pause/resume/stop/cancel/status commands are idempotent; repeated
commands create one effective transition. That runtime contract is
enforced by the owning feature, not by this record.
ResearchRunRef.title: ResearchRunRef

ResultPage.description:
One bounded page of typed result rows.

Pages are planned server-side and bounded to 500 rows / 16 MiB per
Project §15.7; exported full-resolution data is never downsampled.
ResultPage.title: ResultPage

RiskDecision.description:
Canonical governor decision package for one proposed action.

The governor evaluates kill switch, evidence/profile validity,
eligibility, session/news/regime constraints, stop, size,
portfolio/market limits, allocation budget, approval policy, and
capability availability in a fixed documented precedence; earlier
blocking reasons cannot be masked by later approvals.
RiskDecision.title: RiskDecision

RiskEvidenceRef.description:
Reference to one consumed cross-owner source-evidence record.

Owner schema, identity, UTC time, freshness, coverage, provenance,
explicit missingness, and exact units are validated without redefining
the source record itself.
RiskEvidenceRef.title: RiskEvidenceRef

RiskLimitResult.description:
One evaluated limit with its precedence-ordered state.

``(decision_id, precedence)`` uniqueness is enforced by the owning
store because it spans multiple result rows.
RiskLimitResult.title: RiskLimitResult

RiskProfileRef.description: Reference to one risk profile identity.
RiskProfileRef.title: RiskProfileRef

RiskSnapshot.description:
Immutable portfolio/account risk snapshot for one decision.

Pending, open, and reserved exposure are always carried explicitly and
never silently excluded; ``duplicate_treatment`` discloses the
deterministic duplicate and in-flight treatment used.
RiskSnapshot.title: RiskSnapshot

RouteTarget.description:
Wire projection of a navigable route destination (record R2).

Removed routes cannot be resurrected by saved client state; the shell
restores only still-authorized compatible routes.
RouteTarget.title: RouteTargetWire

RunResearchPresentationSuccess.description:
Successful run-research presentation result (port 5).

``preview`` reuses the Interfaces-owned ``ResearchPreview`` and
``run`` the Research-owned ``ResearchRunRef``; the UI never invents
admission or run state.
RunResearchPresentationSuccess.title: RunResearchPresentationSuccess

StartWorkPresentationSuccess.description:
Successful start-work presentation result (port 1).

``recent_routes`` is returned for LIST_RECENT, ``shortcuts`` for
LAUNCH_SHORTCUT, and ``news`` for SHOW_NEWS; SHOW_HOME carries the
provider's home presentation.
StartWorkPresentationSuccess.title: StartWorkPresentationSuccess

TabContribution.description:
Wire projection of a tab contribution (record R19).

Closing a dirty tab requires an explicit resolution.
TabContribution.title: TabContributionWire

TaskContract.description: Declared execution contract for one task type.
TaskContract.title: TaskContract

TaskDefinition.description: One task instance inside a project graph.
TaskDefinition.title: TaskDefinition

TemporalContext.description:
Wire-native temporal context record (record R30).

Defined after its cursor/freshness/gap/resynchronization parts;
registry order still follows the README inventory. Time-domain mixing
is rejected at runtime: widgets show causally consistent evidence or
fail closed.
TemporalContext.title: TemporalContext

TemporalCursor.description:
Wire-native ordered temporal cursor (record R33).

Applications are ordered by the monotonic sequence or the supplied
cursor token.
TemporalCursor.title: TemporalCursor

TemporalSourceRef.description:
Wire-native temporal source and clock identity (record R31).

Defined before the temporal records that embed it; registry order
still follows the README inventory. Source and clock identity are
preserved and never make presentation state authoritative.
TemporalSourceRef.title: TemporalSourceRef

TradeIntentRef.description:
Reference to one exact Strategy intent or manual order (record R8).

Manual actions carry authenticated principal, reason, source interface,
request/correlation IDs, and explicit discretionary identity; they
cannot masquerade as Strategy signals.
TradeIntentRef.title: TradeIntentRef

TradePlan.description:
One validated immutable trade plan (record R9).

Ambiguous or mutable inputs reject before Risk review; the plan hash
pins the exact normalized content.
TradePlan.title: TradePlan

TradingActionPreview.description:
Wire-native governed trading action preview (record R15).

Commit must supply the matching ``preview_hash``; scope or preview
drift requires reconfirmation and no adapter is called directly.
TradingActionPreview.title: TradingActionPreview

TradingReadinessProjection.description:
Wire-native trading readiness projection (record R16).

Stale, unknown, or degraded state is explicit and machine-readable so
consumers can block unsafe commands; cached state is never presented
as authority.
TradingReadinessProjection.title: TradingReadinessProjection

TradingSessionRef.description: Reference to one durable trading session and its explicit mode.
TradingSessionRef.title: TradingSessionRef

TransitionEdge.description: One transition between two task keys of a project graph.
TransitionEdge.title: TransitionEdge

UiCommandDescriptor.description: Wire projection of a shell-invokable command (record R4).
UiCommandDescriptor.title: UiCommandDescriptorWire

UiFailure.description: Structured failure envelope shared by all sixteen UI ports.
UiFailure.title: UiFailure

UiFeatureDescriptor.description: Wire projection of a registered UI feature (record R1).
UiFeatureDescriptor.title: UiFeatureDescriptorWire

UiNotification.description:
Wire projection of an in-client notice (record R14).

Notifications are deduplicated and linked to their owning work; the
v1 lowercase severity values are preserved as-is.
UiNotification.title: UiNotificationWire

ViewPreference.description:
Wire projection of client presentation preferences (record R20).

The v1 lowercase theme strings are preserved as-is; the wire font
scale is a ``DecimalValue`` string, not a binary float.
ViewPreference.title: ViewPreferenceWire

ViewProjection.description: Wire projection of a read-only presentation view (record R6).
ViewProjection.title: ViewProjectionWire

WidgetConfigurationEnvelope.description:
Wire-native widget configuration envelope (record R25).

The ``configuration`` payload is bounded by the widget type's
``configuration_schema``.
WidgetConfigurationEnvelope.title: WidgetConfigurationEnvelope

WidgetInstanceRef.description:
Wire-native widget instance identity record (record R23).

Widget instance identity is never a feature identity.
WidgetInstanceRef.title: WidgetInstanceRef

WidgetLifecycleEvent.description:
Payload for ui.widget-lifecycle events (record R36).

Observational PUBLISH evidence for widget registration, mounting,

a port stream or authoritative business state.
WidgetLifecycleEvent.title: WidgetLifecycleEventPayload

WidgetPlacement.description:
Wire-native widget placement record (record R24).

Defined before ``WidgetTypeDescriptor`` because the descriptor's

inventory. Panel removal leaves no orphan region.
WidgetPlacement.title: WidgetPlacement

WidgetRemovalResult.description:
Wire-native widget removal outcome (record R37).

Exact removal without stale controls, listeners, or state leaks, with
a deterministic fallback focus target.
WidgetRemovalResult.title: WidgetRemovalResult

WidgetStateEnvelope.description:
Wire-native widget presentation-state envelope (record R26).

Presentation state only, never authoritative business state; the

WidgetStateEnvelope.title: WidgetStateEnvelope

WidgetTypeDescriptor.description:
Wire-native widget type registration record (record R22).

``widget_type`` is the stable module slug; widget type identity is
never a product feature identity, which is carried by
``owning_feature``.
WidgetTypeDescriptor.title: WidgetTypeDescriptor

WorkspaceLayoutSnapshot.description:
Wire-native workstation layout snapshot (record R27).

Scoped to one actor, workspace, capability snapshot, and layout
schema; immutable per layout version.
WorkspaceLayoutSnapshot.title: WorkspaceLayoutSnapshot
